description: Escape while a text field holds typed text silently does nothing: no message, no live-region announcement, no visual change. The same key closes the panel when focus is on a select or an empty field, even with a dirty draft.
expected: Escape behaves consistently: either it always closes (the draft is kept in memory anyway) or a brief, announced hint explains why the panel stayed open.
actual: Panel stays open with no feedback (screenshots/step-1.png identical to step-0.png); from the Priority select the same dirty draft closes immediately.
suggested_fix: Since the New task draft survives closing, let Escape close from any field; or show and announce 'Draft kept. Press Escape again to close'.

description: The New task draft is memory-only: a page reload or a project switch and back silently discards title, priority and description. Edit-task drafts persist in sessionStorage, so the two draft models behave differently.
expected: The New task draft survives reload and project switches like edit drafts do, or the app warns before discarding.
actual: After reload the form is empty with P2 (screenshots/edge-reload.png); same after project switch (screenshots/edge-switch.png).
suggested_fix: Store the New task draft in sessionStorage under the same per-workspace/actor key scheme as edit drafts.

description: When the New task panel is swapped for a task detail or closed, nothing indicates that an unsent draft is waiting.
expected: A subtle 'Draft' marker on the New task button while a dirty draft exists.
actual: New task button looks identical with or without a draft.
suggested_fix: Add a dot or 'New task (draft)' label when a dirty draft is held.
